possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Fine-tuned on a 10,000-example dataset derived from alpaca-cleaned and regenerated with owo-speak/uwu-speak, with the dataset generated by Mistral Small 3, but the card does not document the provenance or usage terms of the regenerated synthetic data.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: The card states the dataset was generated by Mistral Small 3 from alpaca-cleaned examples but provides no details on the synthetic data generation process, curation, or dataset composition.

possible_risks.description: Unrepresentative data occurs when the training or fine-tuning data is not sufficiently representative of the underlying population or does not measure the phenomenon of interest. Synthetic data might not fully capture the complexity and nuances of real-world data. Causes include possible limitations in the seed data quality, biases in generation methods, or inadequate domain knowledge. Thus, AI models might struggle to generalize effectively to real-world scenarios.
possible_risks.justification: Fine-tuning on only 10,000 alpaca-cleaned examples regenerated with owo-speak/uwu-speak may not represent general real-world text or tasks, potentially limiting generalization.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: The model is a text-output instruct fine-tune with no reported evaluations, and its training data was generated by another LLM (Mistral Small 3), which can introduce hallucinated or inaccurate content into the training data and outputs.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: The card provides no evaluation results, training details beyond the synthetic fine-tuning dataset, or information about inner workings, limiting transparency.

training_context.adaptations: The model is a fine-tune trained on a dataset generated by Mistral Small 3, using 10,000 alpaca-cleaned examples regenerated with owo-speak/uwu-speak to make Qwen less robotic and less boring.
